verdict: approve scoped exporter boundary test file
independent_resolution: The complete new test file and current exporter/source_path implementation were read, and all six tests were executed independently. Temporary fixtures copy exact source bytes into an isolated directory; all invalid path/identity controls assert ValueError and absent output, making false-positive partial publication observable. The valid repeated export checks rim/tire nodes by native bone binding in the actual GLB; a user-edited GLB triggers rejection and all existing output bytes remain equal. These establish the requested narrow boundary coverage. Missing broader scene/corpus behavior is outside this test file and is covered by separate parser, converter, corpus and browser checks; this resolution does not approve those files or the whole feature.
claim_limits: Approval covers the pinned test file; implementation files are evidence, not this approval scope.
A future edit to these tests needs another review; broader final integration gate remains required.
